text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
We'll be
starting a more rigorous routine
to further
improve performance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're doing extra well today,
Mr. Sun.
It's getting a bit too bright for a
shade chaser like
me, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm already wondering if I'll make it out
alive.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. The summer camp and the race?
It's a lot.
choice_data_list: 『小倉記念』もあるし、頑張らなくちゃな
『小倉記念』もあるし、頑張らなくちゃね

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Kokura is so far from here, which
means less
time for training.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those Umamusume are already so much
better
than me, and now I feel like I'll be
lagging further
behind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Perfect idea! Free transportation and
I'll get
some running in too? Two birds
with one stone.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、小倉へはダッシュで行こう！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's just about 1,000 kilometers, right? That's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
NOT! That'd be insane. Don't even joke
about
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nice Nature's blazing hot
summer camp
has begun.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, how about we keep things just slightly hot?
